title: Smooth sections of a real vector bundle
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real manifold [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold] and $E\to N$ a smooth finite-rank real vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. Define $\Gamma^\infty(E)$ as the real vector space of sections $s$, assigning $s(x)\in E_x$ to every $x\in N$, whose map into the total space of $E$ is smooth; equivalently their coefficient functions in smooth local trivializations are smooth. Addition and real scalar multiplication are pointwise.
